title: "Open folder with" context menu item for folders, like in Dolphin
line: Right-clicking a folder on the desktop now offers "Open Folder With", like in Dolphin.
explanation: The desktop Folder View lists items with desktop:/ URLs. KFileItemActions::insertOpenWithActionsTo returns early for folders whose URL isn't a local file, so desktop folders never got "Open Folder With" (folders in a Folder View pointed at a file:// path already did). FolderModel now gives KFileItemActions the items with their most local URL (desktop:/ items carry their local path), so the entry appears and the chosen app receives the real path.

commits.message:
folder: offer "Open Folder With" for folders on the desktop

Desktop items use desktop:/ URLs, and KFileItemActions skips the Open
With actions for folders that aren't local, so desktop folders had no
"Open Folder With" entry. Hand it the items' local URLs instead.

BUG: 451214
